title: Distressed table
text: Distressed table. I needed a table for my printer, without spending a gold brick.  This fit the bill for me.  I like the distressed look.  The colors are a bit brighter than show in the photo... but I am ok with that.  It came fully assembled and in pretty good shape.  The tap in plastic foot tabs were all displaced... but I didn't see any serious damage - it is "distressed" after all.  I have provided 5 pics with measurements - we will see if the Amazon picture trolls let them be seen... It is fairly light weight... It feels like around 50 lbs... (?) .. It's not an heirloom piece by any means.  I added a pull out, fold up storage box to "hide" a few files... I also purchased that on Amazon - link here: https://smile.amazon.com/gp/product/B019GYOBGE/ref=oh_aui_detailpage_o01_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1  The lower shelf is about 5" off the floor.  I appreciated not having to assemble it!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Powell Furniture Calypso Console Table
features: A single shelf for additional space or decor items
description: The Calypso Collection combines an antique, weathered look with a warm, rustic, industrial feel. Its distressed look is trendy, popular and full of unique character. The console table features three drawers for storage and is nicely accented by antique bronze hardware. A single shelf on the bottom of the console can be used to for additional space or decor items. Some Assembly Required.
